newsitem.title: UK: ICI slips as broker cuts profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: ICI slips as broker cuts profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc fell for a second day as NatWest Securities joined the growing band of brokerages lowering profit estimates for the company, market sources said.

The shares were down 9p at 838-1/2p by early afternoon as NatWest downgraded 1996 forecasts to 635 from 700 million stg, 1997 to 760 from 880 million stg and 1998 to 975 from 1,075 million stg, the sources said.
Dividend forecasts were also eased back for the chemical giant with 1996 cut to 32p from 32.5p and 1997 to 34p from 35p.
NatWest analysts were not immediately available to comment.
